notes.title: Tears Apart Demo Update: Faster, Smoother, and Packed with Cosmic Fixes!
notes.notes:
We’ve just released a shiny new update for the Tears Apart demo, and oh boy, did we fix some things! Here’s what’s changed:
[list]
[*] [b]Map size was HUGE.[/b] Until we add more content, we’ve decided to shrink it a bit. Now you’ll be finding stars more often—no more wandering aimlessly through the cosmos. 🌟
[*] [b]We found a magic button that boosts the game by 30 FPS.[/b] And yes, we pressed it. 💥 You’re welcome.
[*] [b]Interstellar synergies are here![/b] These red-framed beauties are gonna shake things up in the best way possible. 🚀
[*] [b]Enemies scaling too fast? [/b]We noticed it too. Now they’ll chill a little more as you explore.
[*] [b]Fewer enemies per room. [/b]Yep, we’ve toned it down for better readability. Now you can actually see who (or what) is attacking you! 👀
[*] [b]Border rooms were way too big sometimes. [/b]We’ve fixed that, making them much more manageable!
[*] [b]Sound and music settings now work instantly in both the main menu AND the pause menu. [/b]You can now tweak those tunes anytime. 🎶
[*] [b]Dashy enemies nerfed! [/b]They now have a cooldown. No more endlessly dashing enemies harassing you! 😎
[*] [b]Controller dash issue? [/b]Gone! That annoying dash sticking bug when playing with a controller is history.
[*] [b]Room Guards won’t fly out of the room anymore. [/b]They’ve learned to stand their ground—no more knockback throwing them across the galaxy. 💪
[/list]
Thank you all for your feedback and for playing the demo! 🚀 Let us know what you think of these changes, and keep the suggestions coming. Until next time, cosmic adventurers! 🌌✨
